title: Break-ins at the homes of legacy-program colleagues from BAE

tellings.quote: >> That was happening to the people I knew who were in Legacy back at BAE in 2018.

plain: In 2018, people working on a secret effort known as the Legacy programme at BAE Systems, a large defence contractor, had their homes broken into, according to a man named Dylan Borland, who knew them there. Borland repeats what happened to these colleagues rather than to himself. He tells it to suggest that people close to such programmes were being watched or pressured.
